overview_description.description: Al Mal Capital REIT is a real estate investment trust that acquires and manages income-producing property assets under long-term lease agreements in sectors such as healthcare, education, and industrial real estate. It provides investors with access to diversified real estate holdings and distributes income from leased assets.
